page.layout: One page of text. Above the text, a decorative woodcut ornament (not transcribed). Dedication heading in capitals and italics, then one paragraph with a large woodcut initial. At the foot, catchword "dem" at right and signature "A 2" at centre. No margin notes, no running head, no page number.

main_text.head: REVERENDISSIMO IN CHRISTO PATRI, Domino meo colendissimo, Georgio Archiepiscopo Cantuariensi, totius Anglia Primati, Magnæ Britanniæ Regi à secretiori consilio: vitam in Christo beatam, spiritum prudentiæ, fortitudinis, ac sanctificationis, & multiplicem à Domino gratiam, pacemq;.
main_text.p: QUum populus Dei ex Æ-gypto vocatus (Reue-rendissime in Christo Pater, & vigilantissime in Ecclesia Præsul) per varia discrimina in terram promissam renderet per mi-raculosa in Ægypto ostenta, per rubri maris profunda, per desertum Sinæ, per medios hostes Amalachitas, per serpentes igneos, per versutias Balaam, per varia bella cum hostibus ex gigantea progenie, quorum species insolita, urbes vallatæ, ferrei & falcati currus formidinem populo incusserant: quæ videbantur impedimenta, toti-

page.notes: The large woodcut initial is partly hidden; read as Q, so "QUum" is inferred from the visible tail and the word "Vum". The "Q" in the initial is [?] in the printed form. The top ornament is decorative and not transcribed. The printed "pacemq" uses a tilde abbreviation, rendered as "pacemq;". Long s has been normalised to s throughout.
